name: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica Plus
original_name: 神曲奏界ポリフォニカ プラス
source:
This episode, “Farewell Song’, details a spirit beauty pageant where the grand prize is the one-man orchestra of Corticarte’s previous contractor, Kuchiba: ‘Ibara-hime’. Corticarte, Eufinley and other spirits join in the battle for the vintage instrument, as the shrouded past of Kuchiba is gradually revealed.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
本篇《告别之歌》讲述一场精灵选美大赛。
大奖是柯缇卡儿蒂前任契约者库奇巴所留下、被称为“荆棘公主”的一人乐团。
柯缇卡儿蒂、尤芬丽等精灵加入争夺这件古老乐器的战斗，库奇巴被尘封的往事也逐渐揭开。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/07/01/july-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
